restaurant_name: บริษัทดีกู๊ดส์ ซัพพลายจำกัด
text:
Great, friendly service! This was one of the best wax jobs I've had in Chiang Mai. Been living here for 6 years and just when I thought I'd found the perfect place, they closed down. I tried one of the popular places around town and it was terrible. After months of searching I found Dewa. Went there without expectations and it was exceptional! My legs stayed smooth longer than ever. I hope they stay open!
Update January 2020: Had my legs done again and they were consistently perfect!

text:
amazing! considering that I came in with my legs done right before in a shop that had only five star ratings.
So I find a big difference in service but not necessarily in price between nail or massage shops doing the waxing service and only or primarily waxing studios.
Here you'll find an air-conditioned cabin with a table that is big enough to relax on it, a clean sheet under you and a clean blanket to cover you in case you're cold.
If you are going to do a quick half leg all this really doesn't matter so much everything changes though when considering a Brazilian or even a Hollywood. Start out with your leg and then try underarms, this way you'll get a feeling where it goes and how professional the person is working on you.
